entries.final_answer: 52rem. Resolved autonomously from the dispatch brief (issue #154 asks to settle the value by measuring line length). Measured: 45rem = 92-101 chars/line, 52rem = 106-117, 60rem = 123-135. At 1440px a sidebar+rail page is pane-limited to 816px, so 51rem+ fills the pane there; 52rem is the smallest value that does, keeping prose as close to the 45-90 char guideline as the goal allows. Tables get extra room separately. The operator can restate 60rem in review; it is a one-token change.
entries.question: What should the new --dk-width-content default be (issue proposes ~60rem; settle by line-length measurement)?

entries.final_answer: Tables only: a table that is a direct child of the page body grows past the prose column, centred on it, up to the reading pane (never under the TOC rail) and at most a new --dk-width-wide token, from the 72rem breakpoint up. Diagrams already scale to fit and code blocks scroll by convention; both stay in the column. Resolved autonomously from the brief (issue prefers growth when it does not hurt the TOC rail).
